 Actress Taryn Manning has joined the voice cast of Grand Theft Auto VI as Vicki, a supporting character connected to the Starlet Motel and Delights club in Vice City. Her appearance links the Rockstar Games release to the actress best known for portraying Tiffany Pennsatucky Doggett in Netflix's Orange Is the New Black. Players first encounter Vicki during the Just Moved In mission.
 She returns in Girls Trip, when Lucia purchases counterfeit painkillers from her for Jason, before becoming a recurring character in Chapter 2. According to coverage published by AOL and The Times of India on November 21, 2026, Manning is among the performers featured in the game's extensive voice cast. Her credits place her alongside actors and performers including Roselyn Sanchez and Denzel Curry.

 Manning gained widespread recognition through Orange Is the New Black, where she portrayed Tiffany Pennsatucky Doggett. The character initially appeared as one of the first season's principal antagonists before undergoing a significant personal transformation during the series.

 Her character was introduced as a self-described redneck who was imprisoned after shooting a nurse at an abortion clinic. Following support from anti-abortion activists, Pennsatucky adopted a born-again Christian identity in an effort to reduce her sentence, eventually embracing the faith during incarceration. Manning received the role without auditioning.
 Her initial recurring position was subsequently expanded to the main cast, where she remained throughout the show's seven-season run. Her performance also attracted critical acclaim.
 Beyond Netflix, Manning has accumulated television credits across several established productions. She played Mary Ann McGarrett in Hawaii Five-O, Cherry during the first three seasons of Sons of Anarchy, and Rebecca Peabody in the television series Get Real. Her filmography includes 8 Mile (2002), Hustle & Flow (2005), and Karen (2021), in which she played the title character. She has also appeared on America’s Next Top Model, Worst Cooks in America, Hollywood Medium with Tyler Henry, and Hollywood Game Night.

 Manning's entertainment career also includes appearances in music videos for Nickelback's Rockstar and Train's 50 Ways to Say Goodbye. Her musical work provides another connection for players familiar with her previous performances. In 2012, she featured on Send Me Your Love, a collaboration with Sultan + Ned Shepard that reached the top of Billboard's Dance Club Songs chart.
 The track is another possible point of recognition for players encountering her voice in Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Games kept much of the game's casting information confidential before its release, prompting fans to examine character voices and performers' previous credits. The published credits identify Manni L.
 Perez as Lucia and Dylan Rourke as Jason, with Manning among the supporting performers.
